fields.name: PTU_Report_Help
fields.fieldText: All checkboxes must be clicked for the PTU to be approved

fields.name: Packaged_Contents
fields.helpText:
New Item: any damage is a fail

Return Items: surface scratches on packaging is acceptable

fields.name: Body_Condition
fields.helpText: Any damage, discolouration, or sign of Ingress is a fail

fields.name: Filter_Condition
fields.helpText: If its missing or has scratches/damage then fail

fields.name: Sensor_Condition
fields.helpText: Scratches/damage then fail

fields.name: Connections_Condition
fields.helpText: Any damage, discolouration, sign of Ingress, or continuity/functionality issue is a failure

fields.name: Lens_Mount_Inspection
fields.helpText: Any damage, discolouration or if the correct lens does not correctly screw in or fully seat is a failure

fields.name: Video_Signal_Output
fields.helpText: The device must deliver images correctly and have functional IO lines

fields.name: Satisfactory_Image_Quality
fields.helpText: After cleaning if the image has any issues then fail

fields.name: Powered_On_Correctly
fields.helpText: Does the device power on without issue and within the expected timeframe

fields.name: Test_Tag
fields.helpText: If a PSU that uses AC input is included it needs to have a current Test & Tag label
